text: are those standard procedure for you, or did you hand-roll this system as-you-went?

Hand-rolled as we went, over the past weeks, by the agents, one rule at a time. Only the pieces are standard: design docs, tests declared before the code, a generated status file. The combination (Pending.js, edges.js, the board, the scoreboard) is ours, not a known method.

does runAll.js contain test logic for stack-frame capturing?
No. Neither runAll.js nor testSupport.js captures stack frames (no .stack, captureStackTrace or prepareStackTrace). A failure prints its own message line, not where in the code it came from.
wsl-claude: no. runAll.js has none. The only stack capture is spirit/test/tools/wirePaths.js:220, your 09-24 'breakpoint at the post function' idea, which ranks the call paths that reach the wire.
